html:
G'oya

Har bir shartnoma uchun bitta savol: muddatgacha kamida bitta to'lov bormi. Muddat imzolangan oyning boshiga bir oy va to'qqiz kun qo'shilgani, ya'ni keyingi oyning 10-sanasi. Savolga EXISTS javob beradi va har shartnomaga 1 yoki 0 qo'yadi. Keyin imzolangan oy bo'yicha guruhlab, shartnomalarni sanaymiz va birlarni qo'shamiz.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH f AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.signed_on,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM payments p
           WHERE p.contract_id = c.id
             AND p.paid_on <= CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', c.signed_on) + INTERVAL '1 month 9 days' AS DATE)
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ok
  FROM contracts c
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(signed_on, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS contracts,
       SUM(ok) AS on_time,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ok) / COUNT(*), 1) AS on_time_pct
FROM f
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(signed_on, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY month

EXISTS nechta to'lov bo'lishidan qat'i nazar bitta javob beradi: Bekzod muddatgacha ikki marta to'lagan, lekin u bitta shartnoma. Hamma shartnomalar contracts dan keladi, shuning uchun o'z vaqtida to'lagani yo'q oy ham 0 bilan natijada qoladi.

Tuzoqlar

Muddatni "imzolangandan bir oy" deb olish oson, lekin qoida boshqa. Aziz 5-yanvarda imzolagan va 10-fevralda to'lagan: u o'z vaqtida, +1 month esa uning muddatini 5-fevral qiladi.

Noto'g'riWITH f AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.signed_on,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM payments p
           WHERE p.contract_id = c.id AND p.paid_on <= date(c.signed_on, '+1 month')
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ok
  FROM contracts c
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', signed_on) AS month, COUNT(*) AS contracts, SUM(ok) AS on_time,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ok) / COUNT(*), 1) AS on_time_pct
FROM f
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', signed_on)
ORDER BY month

LEFT JOIN bilan yozsangiz, to'lovlarni emas, shartnomalarni sanang (COUNT(DISTINCT p.contract_id)), aks holda ulush 100 dan oshishi mumkin. Muddat sharti ON ichida bo'lsin: WHERE da u hech kim o'z vaqtida to'lamagan oyni natijadan o'chiradi.

Oy raqamiga bir qo'shish dekabrda 13-oyni beradi. Sana arifmetikasini bazaga qoldiring.

Dialektlar farqi

SQLite'da muddat bitta date chaqiruvida, modifikatorlar chapdan o'ngga bajariladi:

Faqat SQLiteWITH f AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.signed_on,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM payments p
           WHERE p.contract_id = c.id
             AND p.paid_on <= date(c.signed_on, 'start of month', '+1 month', '+9 days')
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ok
  FROM contracts c
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', signed_on) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS contracts,
       SUM(ok) AS on_time,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ok) / COUNT(*), 1) AS on_time_pct
FROM f
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', signed_on)
ORDER BY month

Avval oy boshi, keyin bir oy qo'shiladi: 31-yanvardan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri '+1 month' SQLite'da 2-martni berardi.
